title: Kagi Launches Public Beta for New Email Service
excerpt: Kagi has launched a public beta for Kagi Mail, a new email service positioned as an alternative to Gmail featuring no ads and open standards.
body_html:
Kagi has expanded its product offerings by launching a public beta for Kagi Mail, a new email service designed to compete with established providers like Gmail. The company already provides a paid search alternative and the Orion web browser.

According to the announcement, the new email platform focuses on privacy and user control. Key features highlighted for the service include a lack of surveillance, no advertisements, support for open standards, and the avoidance of vendor lock-in.

The introduction of Kagi Mail marks another step for the company as it builds out a suite of tools intended to rival major tech platforms.
